description: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:198: CertificateList::from_der(&self.crl_der) is called on every check_revocation invocation. For a chain of N certificates validated against the same CRL, this is O(N) redundant DER parsing. The doc acknowledges this ('Tracked for v0.3') but there is no tracking issue. In a production deployment validating 1000 chains/second against the same CRL, this is unnecessary CPU work. The fix is to store the parsed CertificateList in the struct at construction time (as the doc suggests).
notes: CrlChecker is typically constructed per-check-call (short-lived). Pre-parsing would require CertificateList to outlive the DER Vec (lifetime issue) or Arc-wrap it. Deferring until usage patterns indicate this is a hot path.
title: CrlChecker re-parses CRL DER on every check_revocation call
